text.zh: 画一株植入苗盘土块的幼苗。
text.en: Draw one seedling rooted in the soil block of a seed tray.

text.zh: 主读新叶叶尖微弯，保留一条清楚的主叶脉。
text.en: Give the focal new leaf a slightly curved tip and one clearly visible main vein.

text.zh: 展现夜间温室，苗盘在近景，冷灰蓝玻璃与窗格退到后景。
text.en: Show a greenhouse at night, with the seed tray in the foreground and cool blue-gray glazing and frames in the background.

text.zh: 用画外右上方的柔光照亮叶缘，周围保持暗冷层次。
text.en: Use soft light from the upper right outside the frame to illuminate the leaf edge, with cool dark layers around it.

text.zh: 把港口水面、船与防波堤留在画外。
text.en: Keep harbor water, boats, and the breakwater out of the scene.

text.zh: 让低饱和冷灰蓝玻璃与暗墙占据大部分画面，小面积琥珀暖色只集中在主读新叶的受光边。
text.en: Let low-saturation cool blue-gray glass and dark walls dominate; confine the small amber accent to the lit edge of the focal new leaf.

text.zh: 主读新叶的受光边最清楚且短而连贯，窗框和远处植物以低反差断边融入邻近色面。
text.en: Keep the lit edge of the focal leaf the clearest, short, continuous contour; merge window frames and distant foliage into adjacent masses with low-contrast broken edges.

text.zh: 叶脉、叶尖和邻近少量湿气承接主要细节，后景植物、玻璃与外墙保持稀疏暗色块。
text.en: Place the main detail in the vein, leaf tip, and a trace of nearby moisture; keep the background plants, glass, and exterior wall as sparse dark masses.

text.zh: 用近处苗盘暗边和远窗框作低反差引导，视线落到具有唯一暖点、清晰边和主要细节的叶尖。
text.en: Use the dark edge of the nearby tray and distant frames as low-contrast cues, ending the gaze at the tip where the only warm accent, clearest edge, and primary detail meet.

text.zh: 大暗色面轻微呈现细纸粒，并保持主视觉细节清楚。
text.en: Let fine paper grain show subtly on broad dark areas, with focal details kept clear.
